caption:
This comet is 50 million miles away. Station crew photographed it.
Comet PanSTARRS (C/2025 R3) shows as a faint streak at the top.
A comet can grow two tails. One is blue gas. One is dust.
Many meteors come from comets. Matching them is tricky.

What the astronomers say: the bright meteor in the APOD probably did not come from this comet.

NASA picture: JSC, iss074e0480485. NASA/Chris Williams, 17 April 2026.
